nodes.name: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs at :17 and :47 past the hour (production only - publish the workflow). Staggered so Companies run before Contacts, Sites, Quotes and Jobs, and offset from the Simpro -> HubSpot syncs.

nodes.name: Build Sync Window
nodes.notes: All settings in plain words + the time window (last saved window end minus 5 min, or the last 35 min on the first run). TEST MODE is switched here.

nodes.name: Find Changed Records
nodes.notes: HubSpot deals in the Quote pipeline changed since the window start, with all the properties needed (200 per page, so no separate read per record).

nodes.name: Prepare Records
nodes.notes: Collects every page into ONE list and applies the test-record rule while TEST MODE is on.

nodes.name: Has Records?
nodes.notes: True: something to sync. False: nothing changed - straight to Finish Run so the window still advances.

nodes.name: Load SPL Users
nodes.notes: Reads the SPL Users table once (HubSpot_ID -> Simpro_ID) for the sales person and project manager.

nodes.name: Build Association Reads
nodes.notes: Which related records does each changed record have in HubSpot? One batch read per link type.

nodes.name: Read Associations
nodes.notes: Batch read of the associations (100 records per call).

nodes.name: Build Related Reads
nodes.notes: Reads the Simpro ID of every related company / contact / site (and the deal line items) in batches of 100.

nodes.name: Any Related Records?
nodes.notes: True: read them. False: no related records at all.

nodes.name: Read Related Objects
nodes.notes: Batch read: the Simpro ID of each related record, and the line item properties.

nodes.name: Resolve Plan
nodes.notes: Per record: where to create/update it in Simpro, the body, and the Simpro IDs of what it links to. Records that cannot be sent yet (a missing parent) are listed, never created half-linked.

nodes.name: Build Simpro Reads
nodes.notes: Compare before write: read what Simpro holds today for records that already have a Simpro ID (throttled, 5 per second).

nodes.name: Any Records To Compare?
nodes.notes: True: there are existing records to read. False: only new records.

nodes.name: Read from Simpro
nodes.notes: Reads each existing record from Simpro so we only write what differs. 404 = deleted in Simpro (reported, not re-created).

nodes.name: Build Record Writes
nodes.notes: New record -> create. Existing record -> update ONLY the fields that differ. Nothing differs = no call.

nodes.name: Any Writes?
nodes.notes: True: something to create or update. False: Simpro is already up to date.

nodes.name: Write Records to Simpro
nodes.notes: Creates (POST) or updates (PATCH), throttled to 5 per second. No automatic retry: a create must never run twice.

nodes.name: Build ID Write-Back
nodes.notes: Saves the new Simpro IDs on the HubSpot records right after they are created (batches of 100), so a re-run cannot create them twice.

nodes.name: Any IDs To Save?
nodes.notes: True: new Simpro IDs to save. False: nothing was created.

nodes.name: Write IDs to HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch update of the Simpro ID property on the HubSpot records.

nodes.name: Build Section Reads
nodes.notes: Deals with line items: read the sections of the Simpro quote/job.

nodes.name: Any Sections To Read?
nodes.notes: True: deals with line items. False: none.

nodes.name: Read Sections
nodes.notes: Simpro sections (cost centers live inside sections).

nodes.name: Build Cost Center Reads
nodes.notes: Only for deals whose line items already exist as cost centers: read them to compare.

nodes.name: Any Cost Centers To Read?
nodes.notes: True: existing cost centers to read. False: all line items are new.

nodes.name: Read Cost Centers
nodes.notes: Simpro cost centers of each section.

nodes.name: Build Dependent Writes
nodes.notes: Custom fields (quotes) and line items -> Simpro cost centers: update the ones that differ, create the new ones. Price = GST-exclusive total.

nodes.name: Any Links Or Cost Centers To Write?
nodes.notes: True: something to write. False: all in sync.

nodes.name: Write Links and Cost Centers
nodes.notes: Custom fields, cost center updates (PATCH) and new cost centers (POST).

nodes.name: Build Line Item Write-Back
nodes.notes: New cost centers: save their Simpro ID and section on the HubSpot line items (batches of 100).

nodes.name: Any Line Items To Save?
nodes.notes: True: line items to save. False: none created.

nodes.name: Write Line Item IDs to HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch update of simpro_id and simpro_section_id on the line items.

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Once per poll. Fails the run if any call failed (window not advanced, next run retries); otherwise saves the new window end and returns a summary.

parameters.content:
## [SPL] HubSpot -> Simpro Quotes Sync
Pushes HubSpot deals in the Quote pipeline to Simpro. One workflow per record type, staggered in dependency order.

**TEST MODE is ON** (Build Sync Window: `testOnly: true`): only test records (name starts with `HSTEST-`, or their own email domain is `aniccadigital.io` / `spl.com.au`) are sent to Simpro. Set it to `false` to send everything.

**What it does:** reads the records changed in HubSpot since the last run (200 per call), compares with Simpro and creates or updates only what differs, saves new Simpro IDs on HubSpot, and sets the links. Records whose parent (company/site) is not in Simpro yet are skipped and listed in the run summary.

**Before publishing (manual steps)**
1. Connect `SPL Simpro` and `SPL Account` on every credentialed node and confirm no 'not connected' warning remains.
2. Set Settings > Error Workflow.
3. Open `Load SPL Users`: it must read the SPL Users data table.

**First backfill:** set `windowStartOverride` (for example `2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`) for one run, then clear it.
